name: crosswalk
description: Warns you (never blocks) when Claude is about to edit a file that's also changed in an open GitHub pull request: a line above the prompt and a one-time toast. /crosswalk lists the files your branch shares with open PRs.

showTitles.title: Show PR titles
showTitles.description: Show the pull request's title in the band and the toast (cleaned and cut short). Never sent to Claude.

showAuthors.title: Show PR authors
showAuthors.description: Show who opened the pull request in the band, the toast and /crosswalk.

includeMine.title: Include my own PRs
includeMine.description: Also warn about pull requests you opened yourself (the one for your current branch is always skipped).
